name: Phainon
description: Also known by the name Khaslana, Phainon is the demigod of Worldbearing and a Chrysos Heir from Aedes Elysiae whose story centers on enduring millions of repeated cycles to prevent the emergence of Irontomb, the Emanator of Destruction. As a Physical Destruction DPS, he can enter an Enhanced State for devastating follow-up attacks.
